name: George Wright Golf Course
location: Hyde Park, Boston, Suffolk County, Massachusetts
architects: Donald Ross; built by the Works Progress Administration, opened 23 April 1938 (City of Boston)

dtm.source: bare earth from the ground points (class 2) of the 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1476274), gridded to 1 m in EPSG:32619 by pipeline/intake.py dtm (mean per cell, gaps filled linearly from their rim); NAVD88 m

laz.source: 2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 9777, job J1476274), flown 20 March 2021 (GPS times), leaf-off; vegetation classes 3-5; NAD83(2011) / Massachusetts Mainland (EPSG:6491, m), NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, ma2021_cent_east_J1476274.zip, clipped to the world with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

ortho.source: USDA NAIP via the USGS National Map ImageServer, exported by the developer 2026-10-25 as one JPEG at 0.5 m in EPSG:32619 (release assorted-lidar-data: 12.jpg), placed by its request box by pipeline/intake.py ortho; flight year not stated

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 29830747) bbox 1,028 x 1,517 m in UTM 19N + ~120 m scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,280 m east-west (126 m each side), 1,792 m north-south (138 m each side)

scorecard_source: Stymie (stymie.golf/golf-courses/massachusetts/suffolk-county/hyde-park/george-wright-golf-course), read 2026-10-25: Blue, White, Gold and Red per hole ('2017' sets), par 70, stroke index; every row adds up. OpenGolfAPI's per-hole Blue row is the same (6,506; its tee table says 6,440 and 69.5/126). Rating 71.9/133 (Stymie; Wikipedia agrees). Unverified third-party card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar), via NOAA Digital Coast
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-25: not scouted; course identified from the lidar order's footprint (centre 42.267, -71.132; Wikipedia 42.268, -71.133). Standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from lidar). Played from Blue, the tips (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). Wind 1-9 mph (inland New England). Bare earth from the lidar's ground points: the release has no DEM. Theme george_wright: the course's own, from the developer's photos (developer: a new theme for each course).
red_water_note: ponds inside the boundary mapped as natural=water (in the woods west of 4-7 and north of 3): red penalty areas (standing default)
rough_band_note: a mown band of rough along the fairways, then the long golden native grass the photos show beside many holes

drop_trees.reason: course chat 2026-10-25: a 49.8 m 'conifer' among the apartment blocks at the world's north-west corner, out of bounds; the next tallest crown in the world is 31.8 m, so it is a structure the lidar classed as vegetation
